'''Peter Paetzold''' (March 16, 1935 – August 17, 2023<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.iac.rwth-aachen.de/cms/IAC/Das-Institut/Aktuelle-Meldungen/~bdhbtx/Nachruf-fuer-Herrn-Prof-Dr-Paetzold/?mobile=1|title=Nachruf fuer Herrn Prof. Dr. Paetzold - RWTH AACHEN UNIVERSITY Institut fuer Anorganische Chemie - Deutsch|language=de|access-date=2024-04-21|publisher=www.iac.rwth-aachen.de}}</ref>) was a German chemist and emeritus professor of inorganic chemistry at [[RWTH Aachen University]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.ac.rwth-aachen.de/extern/paetzold/cv.html|title=Peter Paetzold CV|last=|first=|date=|website=www.ac.rwth-aachen.de|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2019-01-27}}</ref>

== Life ==
He studied at [[LMU Munich]].<ref name=":0" /> In 1961, he received his doctorate in the working group of [[Egon Wiberg]]; in his dissertation he dealt with the thermal decomposition of borazides.<ref name=":0" /> After his habilitation (1966), he taught for two more years at LMU Munich.<ref name=":0" /> He then moved to a chair of Inorganic Chemistry at [[RWTH Aachen University]].<ref name=":0" /> In his research, he mainly dealt with the molecular chemistry of the element boron, especially with iminoboranes and cluster compounds.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ac.rwth-aachen.de/extern/paetzold/res.html|title=Paetzold Research|last=|first=|date=|website=www.ac.rwth-aachen.de|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2019-01-27}}</ref> His list of publications includes about 180 papers. Paetzold retired in 2000.<ref name=":0" /> After various books and textbooks on chemistry, he published a textbook on general chemistry in autumn 2009.<ref name=":1">Paetzold, P.: ''Chemie - Eine Einführung -'', Walter de Gruyter Berlin und New York, 2009, {{ISBN|978-3-11-020268-7}}</ref> In 2015, a scientific colloquium in his honor took place.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.prorwth.de/foerdern/foerderprojekte/beitrag/?tx_ttnews%5Btt_news%5D=31&cHash=077b00af5a164e95caf78bdb419883da|title=Das Jubiläum "100pro RWTH!" {{!}} fördern {{!}} Förderprojekte {{!}} Beitrag|website=www.prorwth.de|access-date=2019-01-27}}</ref>
He was married and had 4 children.<ref name=":0" />
